title: Prohibited Weapons and Devices
grade_or_penalty: 3rd degree for destructive devices and sawed-off shotguns; 4th degree for most others (silencers, defaced firearms, body armor-penetrating bullets, hollow-nose ammunition outside exemptions, large capacity magazines and certain other items)
key_points: Knowingly possessing items on the prohibited list unless an exemption in 2C:39-6 applies.
